_comment: FlowHQ services the system may recommend. Only services with enabled=true are ever suggested. Review every entry and disable anything FlowHQ cannot currently deliver. 'signals' lists the website observations a service can address (see lib/signals.js); 'weight' scales how strongly that observation supports the service. Benefit statements are the only benefit wording the email writer may use.

services.name: Online booking and appointment reminders
services.description: Lets customers book or request appointments online, with automatic confirmations, reminders and rescheduling links.
services.pitch: an online booking option with automatic confirmations and reminders
required_integrations: Existing calendar or practice-management system (e.g. Google Calendar, Cliniko, Square Appointments)
services.limitations: Depends on the business's calendar or practice-management system offering an integration; some regulated industries need extra privacy review.
approved_benefits: customers can book at a time that suits them, including outside opening hours
fewer phone calls and emails spent arranging times
automatic reminders that can help reduce missed appointments
example_use_cases: Dental clinic online booking with SMS reminders

services.name: AI phone receptionist
services.description: Answers inbound calls when the team is busy or closed, captures the caller's details and reason for calling, and passes a summary to the team.
services.pitch: an AI receptionist that answers calls when the team is busy or closed and sends you a summary of each one
required_integrations: Call forwarding from the business's phone number
Email, SMS or CRM for call summaries
services.limitations: Needs the business to forward calls; it handles routine calls and hands off anything complex to a person.
approved_benefits: calls outside opening hours or during busy periods still get answered
the team receives a short summary of each call instead of a voicemail
routine questions can be answered without interrupting staff
example_use_cases: After-hours call answering for a plumbing business
Overflow calls for a busy clinic front desk

services.name: Enquiry acknowledgement and follow-up
services.description: Sends an immediate, personalised acknowledgement to each website enquiry, organises the details, notifies the right person and schedules follow-up reminders.
services.pitch: an automated enquiry workflow that acknowledges each new request straight away, organises the details and reminds the team to follow up
services.limitations: Works best when enquiries arrive through a form or a single inbox.
approved_benefits: every enquiry gets a prompt acknowledgement, even when the team is busy
enquiry details arrive organised in one place
follow-ups happen consistently instead of relying on memory
example_use_cases: Auto-acknowledge and route contact-form enquiries to the right team member

services.name: Online quote-request workflow
services.description: A short guided quote-request form that collects the job details up front, acknowledges the request and notifies the team.
services.pitch: a short online quote-request form that collects the job details up front and acknowledges each request automatically
services.limitations: Final pricing still comes from the business; the workflow collects the details needed to quote.
approved_benefits: customers can request a quote whenever suits them
the team receives the details needed to quote without back-and-forth
each request gets an immediate acknowledgement
example_use_cases: Electrician quote form with photo upload and instant acknowledgement

services.name: Lead capture and CRM automation
services.description: Captures enquiries from the website, email and phone into one organised list or CRM, with automatic tagging and reminders.
services.pitch: a simple enquiry form connected to an organised enquiry list, so every request is captured in one place
services.limitations: Requires agreement on where enquiries should be stored.
approved_benefits: enquiries from different channels end up in one organised place
less manual copying of enquiry details
it's easier to see which enquiries still need a reply
example_use_cases: Website form plus inbox parsing into a shared CRM

services.name: AI website assistant
services.description: An assistant on the website that answers common questions from the business's own content and collects enquiry details when someone is ready to get in touch.
services.pitch: an AI assistant on the website that answers common questions from your own content and collects enquiry details
services.limitations: Answers only from approved content and hands off anything it cannot answer.
approved_benefits: visitors get answers to common questions straight away
fewer repetitive questions reach the team
enquiry details are collected even outside business hours
example_use_cases: FAQ assistant for a veterinary clinic that also collects appointment requests

services.name: Client onboarding and intake forms
services.description: Replaces downloadable paperwork with online intake forms that feed directly into the business's systems, with automatic reminders to complete them.
services.pitch: online intake forms that feed straight into your systems, with automatic reminders to complete them
required_integrations: Practice-management system, CRM or secure storage
services.limitations: Health and legal businesses may need specific privacy and data-storage requirements reviewed.
approved_benefits: clients can complete forms online before their first visit
less time re-typing details from paper or PDF forms
automatic reminders for forms that haven't been completed
example_use_cases: New-patient intake form for a physiotherapy clinic

services.name: Website enquiry journey improvements
services.description: Small website changes that make the next step obvious, such as a clear call to action and contact options that are easy to find.
services.pitch: a few small website changes that make the next step obvious, such as a clear call to action and easy-to-find contact options
services.limitations: Recommendations are based on a limited review of public pages, not analytics.
approved_benefits: visitors can see the next step quickly
it's easier for interested customers to get in touch
example_use_cases: Adding a clear 'Book a consultation' button and contact details to the homepage

services.name: Review-request automation
services.description: Automatically asks happy customers for a review after a completed job or appointment.
services.pitch: an automatic review request sent after each completed job or appointment
services.limitations: Must follow the review platform's rules; no incentives or review gating.
approved_benefits: review requests go out consistently after each job
less manual effort spent asking for reviews
example_use_cases: Google review request sent the day after a completed service

services.name: Customer support triage
services.description: Sorts incoming messages by topic and urgency and routes them to the right person, with suggested replies for common questions.
services.pitch: a workflow that sorts incoming messages by topic and urgency and routes them to the right person
services.limitations: Suggested replies are reviewed by staff before sending.
approved_benefits: urgent messages reach the right person sooner
less time spent sorting the inbox
example_use_cases: Routing service, billing and booking emails to different team members

services.name: Internal reporting and admin automation
services.description: Automates repetitive admin such as weekly enquiry summaries, data entry between systems and status reports.
services.pitch: automating repetitive admin such as weekly enquiry summaries
services.limitations: Not recommended from a website review alone; only discussed once internal processes are known.
approved_benefits: less time spent on repetitive admin
example_use_cases: Weekly summary of new enquiries and bookings emailed to the owner
